g.text: Minsky Subsurface Hierarchy Dictionary (Masur-Minsky 2000 / Ending Lamination Theorem 2010):
1. Collar Pinch alpha_{Y2}: Step-1 E2 kills all Y2-monomials at deg 6 (35->5) and deg 7 ([1,1,1,0]: 34->21),
topologically isolating the complementary 5-variable subsurface Y2 = 0.
2. Collar Pinch alpha_{a0}: Linear-anchor quadrics Q_1..Q_5 isolate a_0 from the 4-variable core (a_1..a_4).
3. Ending Lamination nu_end: Complete intersection P_core = (Q_6..Q_9) + Kramers seam (a_3 - a_4) forces H_0 = 0.
